claim_decisions: Do not claim Git or GitHub is universally broken.
A full clone is one mode; shallow, partial, and sparse options exist.
Growth: approximately 2,500/day in May versus >30,000/day in September 2026.
200x compares infrastructure CPU and memory footprint, not all operations or end-to-end developer speed.
25% concerns CI CPU capacity, not all company compute.
Scion targets unusual enormous monorepos; online availability and bespoke tooling are tradeoffs.
The animated parser.ts example is explanatory, not an observed benchmark.
